Decode a producer quality layer

cl_qa_decode.Rd

Translates a bit-packed or categorical QA band into the standard class vocabulary of cl_classes, using the sensor driver's specification.

For bit-packed layers, each flag is either a single bit or a field of several bits with the values that raise it (see cl_qa_spec); flags the specification does not define are never raised. For categorical layers, pixels whose code is neither a cloud, cloud-shadow or snow class nor listed in the specification's clear set are invalid and reported as fill. For Sentinel-2 SCL this marks no-data and saturated or defective pixels (classes 0 and 1) as invalid, and counts topographic cast shadow (class 2), vegetation, bare soil, water and unclassified pixels (classes 4 to 7) as valid and cloud-free. Missing values are invalid for both types.

Usage

cl_qa_decode(qa, sensor, include_cirrus = TRUE, confidence = "medium")

Arguments

qa

QA matrix or SpatRaster.

sensor

Sensor id or driver.

include_cirrus

Treat flagged cirrus as cloud. Ignored for sensors whose QA has no cirrus flag.

confidence

Minimum cloud confidence ("medium" or "high") for bit-packed QA with confidence fields. Pixels at or above it are cloud, in addition to those with the cloud bit set. The lowest level is not offered because the Landsat Collection 2 algorithm assigns it to almost all clear pixels.

Value

A list of logical matrices: cloud, shadow, snow, water, fill, plus class in the standard vocabulary.
